projects.title: SEO Generator
projects.description: An AI-powered SEO generator that assists users in optimizing blog content for search engines to boost visibility and organic growth. Built as part of my Prompt Engineer Internship at Future Intern.
projects.problem: Small businesses and content creators struggled to optimize their content for search engines, leading to poor visibility and low organic traffic.
projects.solution: Developed an AI-powered SEO generator that analyzes blog content and provides actionable optimization suggestions, helping users improve search rankings and drive organic growth.
projects.learnings: Deepened understanding of AI/ML integration in web applications, SEO best practices, and building user-friendly SaaS tools.

projects.title: Website Generator

projects.learnings: Gained experience in AI-powered code generation, prompt engineering, and building accessible tools for non-technical users.

projects.title: White Hydrogen – Scope in India
projects.description: Explored the potential of naturally occurring hydrogen reserves in India, assessing feasibility and future opportunities for clean energy development.
projects.problem: The potential of naturally occurring (white) hydrogen reserves in India remained largely unexplored and unassessed.
projects.solution: Conducted comprehensive research on white hydrogen reserves in India, assessing their feasibility and potential for clean energy development.
projects.learnings: Gained insights into geological hydrogen systems, energy policy frameworks, and India's clean energy transition landscape.
